title: API 參考
content:
Photon Engine provides a high-performance, strictly-typed API surface. Below are the primary technical interfaces for building Bun-native applications.

The Gravito Class

interface Gravito {
  get(path: string, ...handlers: Handler[]): this;
  post(path: string, ...handlers: Handler[]): this;
  use(middleware: Middleware): this;
  fetch(request: Request): Promise<Response>;
}

Technical Constants

  • ENGINE_VERSION: 1.2.0
  • DEFAULT_PORT: 3000
  • BUFFER_STRATEGY: Zero-Copy
